correctness.rationale: The exact published 6-by-24 ternary matrix has rank 6 and nonzero Gram determinant. Exhaustive RREF enumeration covers all 56631 nonzero-dimensional message subspaces, with image-support and annihilator counts agreeing for every case. The hierarchy and all support spectra follow by exact minima. Distinct projective columns rule out dual weights 1 and 2; exhaustive normalized three-column relations give exactly three projective supports and therefore six weight-3 dual words.
